title: RBAC + workspace settings for cost visibility, exports, and share links (Usage Insights)
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
## Context
Usage Insights adds cost/usage breakdowns by route + model. We need consistent permissions across:
- viewing cost metrics in Console
- API access to cost/usage breakdown endpoints
- CSV export generation + downloads
- shareable report links (download + deep link)

This ticket implements the RBAC checks and workspace-level controls so customers (esp. fintech / regulated) can restrict who sees cost and who can export/share.

Primary stakeholders:
- Product: Marissa Cole, Paula Mendes
- Security: Marcus Lin, Naomi Feldman, Kevin Osei
- Platform Auth/RBAC: Ethan Park

## Problem statement
Today, any user who can access the Console can often infer spend via usage pages. With Usage Insights adding explicit $ fields and exports, we need a clear permission model + audit trail.

Requirements:
1) Workspace setting to control cost visibility (hide cost for non-authorized roles)
2) Role checks for:
   - cost views (tables, top drivers cards, drilldowns)
   - export initiation + export download
   - share link creation + share link access
3) Audit logging for exports and share links (creation, download/access)
4) Totals must remain queryable for authorized users with correct RBAC filtering (do not break billing reconciliation flows)

## Proposed permission model
### New permissions (AuthZ scopes)
- `cost.read` — ability to view currency-denominated fields and any derived cost driver explanations that include currency.
- `cost.export` — ability to start CSV export jobs and download export artifacts.
- `cost.share` — ability to create share links for cost reports.

Notes:
- `cost.export` implies `cost.read`.
- `cost.share` implies `cost.read`.

### Workspace setting: Cost visibility
Add workspace setting `cost_visibility_mode`:
- `admins_and_billing_only` (default for new workspaces enabling Usage Insights beta)
- `all_members`
- `owners_only` (for highly restricted environments)

Mapping (initial pass; can be tuned later):
- Owner: `cost.read`, `cost.export`, `cost.share`
- Admin: `cost.read`, `cost.export`, `cost.share` (unless mode == owners_only)
- Billing Admin / Finance role: `cost.read`, `cost.export` (share optional; default on)
- Developer/Member: only gets `cost.read` if mode == all_members
- Viewer/Read-only: never gets cost permissions unless explicitly granted via a workspace-level finance role

Implementation detail: workspace setting gates *all* cost permissions regardless of role.

## Console behavior
- If user lacks `cost.read`:
  - Replace $ fields with "—" and show a callout: "You don’t have permission to view cost for this workspace. Ask a workspace admin to grant access."
  - Still allow viewing non-cost usage metrics where safe (requests, tokens, latency), as long as those endpoints are permitted by existing usage permissions.
  - Top drivers: show token-based drivers only (no $), or hide entire module if it’s too confusing. (Decision below.)

- If user lacks `cost.export`:
  - Export CTA hidden/disabled + permission denied toast on direct navigation.

- If user lacks `cost.share`:
  - Share link CTA hidden/disabled.

## API behavior
All insights endpoints that return cost fields must enforce `cost.read`. Export endpoints enforce `cost.export`. Share endpoints enforce `cost.share`.

Expected endpoints (from ENG-3814 / API contract):
- `GET /v1/usage/insights/breakdown` -> requires `cost.read` if `include_cost=true` OR if cost fields are part of default response
- `GET /v1/usage/insights/top-drivers` -> requires `cost.read` (copy includes spend deltas)
- `POST /v1/usage/insights/exports` -> requires `cost.export`
- `GET /v1/usage/insights/exports/{export_id}` -> requires `cost.export` (status)
- `GET /v1/usage/insights/exports/{export_id}/download` -> requires `cost.export` (signed URL)
- `POST /v1/usage/insights/shares` -> requires `cost.share`
- `GET /v1/usage/insights/shares/{share_id}` -> requires auth + `cost.read` (no unauthenticated links for beta)

## Audit logging
### Events
Emit audit events in the central audit log stream:
- `usage_insights.export_created`
- `usage_insights.export_downloaded`
- `usage_insights.share_link_created`
- `usage_insights.share_link_accessed`

### Required fields (minimum)
- actor_user_id
- actor_role_at_time
- workspace_id
- project_id (if filter applied)
- environment (if filter applied)
- time_range_start / time_range_end
- filters_summary (route/model/deployment_mode/region)
- export_id / share_id
- ip_address
- user_agent
- result (success/denied)

### Limits / throttles
- Rate limit export creation per workspace to prevent abuse (handled in ENG-3816, but audited here).
- Share links expire by default (7 days) for beta.

## Decisions
- Top drivers visibility for non-cost viewers: **Hide module** (do not show token-only drivers yet). Rationale: driver copy is framed in spend and tends to confuse when $ is missing; revisit post-beta with UX research.

## Acceptance criteria
- Workspace admin can set cost visibility mode; changes take effect within 1 minute.
- Users without `cost.read`:
  - cannot see currency fields in Console or API responses
  - receive consistent 403/permission error for cost endpoints
  - cannot access share links that contain cost info
- Users without `cost.export`:
  - cannot create or download exports
- Users without `cost.share`:
  - cannot create share links
- Audit events are emitted for export/share creation + access; Security signs off on fields.
- E2E tests cover the three main roles (Owner, Admin, Member) across two workspace modes (admins_only, all_members).

## Implementation plan
1) Add `cost_visibility_mode` to workspace settings (control plane) + UI toggle (admin settings page).
2) Extend AuthZ policy engine:
   - add scopes and role mappings
   - include workspace setting gate
3) Gate Console routes + components:
   - Usage Insights pages
   - Export modal
   - Share link modal
4) Gate API handlers in insights query service:
   - centralized middleware `requirePermission("cost.read")`
   - ensure exports/share endpoints use stronger scopes
5) Add audit log emitters:
   - export created/downloaded
   - share created/accessed
   - include filters summary and result
6) QA + verification in beta allowlist accounts (Northstar Fintech expected to test this heavily)

## Testing
- Unit: policy evaluation matrix for roles x workspace mode
- Integration: API tests returning 403/200 with correct redaction
- E2E: Cypress flows for export and share
- Security: verify audit logs in staging, confirm PII policy (no prompt content, no raw request bodies)

## Rollout
- Behind feature flag `usage_insights_beta` (ENG-3825)
- Default workspace mode set to `admins_and_billing_only` when beta enabled
- Announce in beta onboarding doc: "Cost visibility is restricted by default"

comments: 2026-01-22 — Naomi Feldman: Please ensure share links are authenticated for beta (no public links). Also need audit log fields for both export *creation* and *download*; download is the event auditors care about.

2026-01-24 — Ethan Park: RBAC should be enforced in the insights query service (server-side). Console-only gating isn’t sufficient. Suggest new scopes `cost.read/export/share` rather than reusing billing scopes, to keep least privilege.
2026-01-27 — Kevin Osei: For audit logs, avoid logging raw route strings if they can contain untemplated IDs. Use normalized route template in `filters_summary` (see route normalization ADR).
2026-02-02 — Marissa Cole: Default should be restrictive. Customers have asked for finance-only access. Let’s keep top drivers hidden when user can’t view cost to avoid confusion.

2026-02-06 — Kaitlyn Nguyen: Implemented workspace setting gate + new scopes in AuthZ service. Added middleware in query service for `cost.read`. Export/share endpoints use `cost.export`/`cost.share`.
Open item: wiring share-link access event emission once share endpoint lands.

2026-02-10 — Marcus Lin: Security review: approved direction. Required audit fields added; ensure result=denied is logged for permission failures on export/share attempts (helps detect misconfig + brute force).

2026-02-14 — Kaitlyn Nguyen: PR up with Console gating + API checks + audit events for export create/download and share create/access. Added redaction to ensure $ fields never serialize when missing `cost.read` (server-side).

2026-02-19 — Dylan Brooks: Merged. Verified in staging: member in `admins_and_billing_only` sees tokens/requests but not cost; export button hidden; direct API export call returns 403. Audit events visible in audit viewer. Shipping behind allowlist.
